def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    l = len(s)
    c = 0
    i = 0
    while i < l - 1:
        if s[i] == s[i + 1]:
            z = 1
            j = i
            while j < l - 1 and s[j] == s[j + 1]:
                z += 1
                j += 1
            if z % 2 == 0:
                c += 1
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
    print(c)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
